title: Recovering Lost Details: Multi-Scale Frequency Compensation for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.24229v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting has made significant progress by leveraging multi-scale information to capture hierarchical temporal patterns and model long-range dependencies. However, temporal downsampling in existing multi-scale methods inevitably smooths detailed temporal fluctuations, and this information loss is further aggravated by their emphasis on dominant trends across scales, resulting in insufficiently expressive representations. To address this, we propose a Multi-Scale Wavelet Mixing (MWMixer) model, which incorporates a Bidirectional Frequency-Bands Mixing strategy to recover lost temporal details across scales, enabling complementary cross-scale information interactions. Then, a Dynamic Scale-Adaptive Fusion module learns time-varying weights for each scale to fuse multi-scale forecasts into the final prediction, enhancing the flexibility of multi-scale aggregation. translated_title: 恢复丢失的细节：面向长期时间序列预测的多尺度频率补偿
translated_abstract: 长期时间序列预测通过利用多尺度信息来捕捉层次化的时间模式并建模长程依赖，已取得显著进展。然而，现有多尺度方法中的时间下采样不可避免地平滑了细节性的时间波动，而这种信息损失又因方法对跨尺度主导趋势的强调而进一步加剧，导致表示的表达能力不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了多尺度小波混合模型，该模型引入双向频带混合策略来恢复跨尺度丢失的时间细节，实现互补的跨尺度信息交互。随后，动态尺度自适应融合模块为每个尺度学习时变权重，将多尺度预测融合为最终预测，增强了多尺度聚合的灵活性。此外，跨尺度一致性损失对各尺度（的预测进行对齐……摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出多尺度小波混合模型MWMixer，通过双向频带混合策略恢复下采样丢失的时间细节，并结合动态尺度自适应融合模块与跨尺度一致性损失，提升长期时间序列预测的精度与灵活性。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Multi-Scale Wavelet Mixing (MWMixer) model, which recovers temporal details lost through downsampling via a bidirectional frequency-bands mixing strategy, combined with dynamic scale-adaptive fusion and cross-scale consistency loss, to improve long-term time series forecasting.
